title: Odile and the Static
author: A. M. Villalobos
blurb: Oscar Fairweather, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the fleet's truce expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
